content.text: No employee non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant appears anywhere in the agreement.

input.rationale: The agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce" and "personnel" return only unrelated hits (§ 7 unsolicited commercial e-mail; indemnity and access provisions referencing "employees"). The Client covenants in § 8 are limited to legal compliance, notification, access restriction, credit data licensing, content representations and anti-spamming — none restricts our ability to hire or solicit TrueLink personnel. This matches the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline is required. Since the absence of the restriction benefits us, we should not volunteer a mutual non-solicit; if TrueLink raises one in negotiation, we would hold it to the fallback (services personnel only, 12 months from end of involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
